source_caption_text:
NLE Choppa was in a crazy flow state on “Shotta Flow 6” 😤🔥

NLE Choppa released “Shotta Flow 6 (FINALE)” in January 2022 as the opening track on his Me vs. Me mixtape. The song continued the “Shotta Flow” series that helped put him on the map back in 2019.

Choppa switches up his flow throughout the track, throwing out punchlines and keeping the same energy from start to finish. Rather than following a typical song structure with a hook and chorus, he delivers one long verse that lets him show off his style.

The music video brings back the raw feel of the original “Shotta Flow,” with NLE Choppa and a crowd going crazy throughout the visuals. With “FINALE” in the title, the track felt like his way of closing out one of the biggest series of his career.

#nlechoppa #shottaflow #hiphop
